author: kycrafft
body:
This started off as kind of a joke idea on a CTW thread. I was thinking I might as well just suggest it. 

Capture the pig is similar to capture the wool. There are a few pig room for each side. Upon entering the pig room, players will come across a pig spawner that spawns pigs with saddles (and various other chests). Using a carrot on a stick from the spawn load out, they must ride the pig back to their side and into a fenced area. When this are detects the pig, it kills it ( D: ) and scores your team a point. Pigs from any pig room can score a point and the team that reaches the point limit wins. 

Got it so far?

When you get on the pig, you must ride it back the whole way. So sorry but you can't get off until you die or make it. The pig only dies when you do and has resistance 5 and speed 2 and takes no knockback. You, on the pig have resistance 3,  haste 2, strength 1, and do 50% more knockback. (Just an idea). Once again, you cannot get off the pig. 

Thats kind of my idea I guess. Void maps won't be as good for this, though.
